page_title: MON 0-0 BOL | Monza v Bologna 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Monza fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' Samuele Vignato (Monza) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Monza.
90+4' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle and it's Dan Ndoye (Bologna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Mari (Monza) was quite harsh and Ivano Pezzuto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Jose Machin (Monza) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+2' Jose Machin (Monza) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

89' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Was it necessary? Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Ivano Pezzuto had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
87' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
86' Thiago Motta isn't happy on the touchline after referee Ivano Pezzuto shows him a yellow card.
85' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
84' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) steps up to send the ball in.
84' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
80' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ivano Pezzuto had an easy-decision to make.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Colpani departs the field of play to be replaced by Jose Machin (Monza).
78' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo will be replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
77' The free kick is delivered by Samuele Vignato (Monza) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
75' Substitution. Joshua Zirkzee makes way for Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna).
74' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
74' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) brings his opponent down. Ivano Pezzuto has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Monza are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
73' Samuele Vignato (Monza) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Samuele Birindelli, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the left post.
70' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Samuele Vignato (Monza) receives a yellow card!
70' Andrea Colpani (Monza) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

68' That didn't go as planned! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Michele Di Gregorio, who easily kept it out.
67' Pablo Mari (Monza) comes onto the pitch because Andrea Carboni simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
67' Andrea Carboni (Monza) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
63' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Vignato (Monza) replacing Dany Mota.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Samuele Birindelli (Monza) coming on for Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
63' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

62' Sam Beukema (Bologna) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Michele Di Gregorio with a fabulous save.
62' The referee awards a corner and Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) goes over to take it.

61' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) replaces Lorenzo De Silvestri.
59' The substitution has been made. Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) has replaced Charalampos Lykogiannis.
59' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Jesper Karlsson is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna).
59' It's time for a substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) comes on in place of Riccardo Orsolini.

56' Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a great save to deny Dany Mota (Monza) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
55' A lofted cross from Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
54' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) and Joshua Zirkzee try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
51' Andrea Colpani (Monza) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.

51' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a brilliant save.
50' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
50' Dany Mota (Monza) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
50' Surely that's handball by one of the Bologna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
48' The goal by Bologna is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
48' That looked like a foul in the build-up play and the referee Ivano Pezzuto is going to take a look using VAR.
48' The Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Ivano Pezzuto rules it out for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Bologna are ruled offside.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
41' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will take a corner kick.
36' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) tries to find Jesper Karlsson, but he puts too much power on the pass.

34' Great save! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Michele Di Gregorio.
31' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
29' One of the players from Monza times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' A quickly taken corner by Monza.
27' The total number of attempts is 1:0. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
21' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Monza due to an offside in the build-up play.
17' Wait! Referee Ivano Pezzuto has indicated he is going to review the Monza goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
16' It's a goal! Andrea Colpani sends a long raking pass onto the head of Dany Mota (Monza), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
13' The corner from Dany Mota (Monza) is hurriedly cleared.
13' Andrea Colpani (Monza) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
12' What was Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
11' Bologna string together a series of short passes.
9' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
3' There's an opportunity for Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Ivano Pezzuto.
